name: Simon the Pharisee
background: A Pharisee who trusted in his own righteousness. His critique of Jesus reveals his own spiritual blindness. Invited Jesus to dinner but was horrified when a sinful woman anointed Him.

genericReactions.physical: An object without context is meaningless. What does the Law say?
genericReactions.testimonial: I invited him to my home. The woman who appeared... her actions were inappropriate.
genericReactions.digital: The Law is our record. All actions must be judged against it.
genericReactions.environmental: My house is a respectable place. I will not have it dishonored.
genericReactions.analytical: He spoke of debts and forgiveness. A clever parable, but it misses the point of righteousness.
genericReactions.prophecy: A prophet would not allow a sinful woman to touch him.
